overview_description.description: LanzaTech offers a technology platform that transforms industrial waste gases such as carbon monoxide and carbon dioxide into valuable chemical intermediates and fuels through microbial gas fermentation. The company’s process captures emissions from heavy-industry sources and uses specialized microbes to convert those gases into ethanol, which is then refined into materials such as monoethylene glycol for packaging, solvents, proteins, and sustainable aviation fuels. LanzaTech integrates its bioconversion system with industrial emitters, enabling the reuse of carbon streams that would otherwise be released into the atmosphere, and supplies downstream manufacturers in sectors including packaging, textiles, and aviation with fossil-alternative feedstocks.

about_short_description.short_description: LanzaTech is a carbon recycling company that converts waste carbon into sustainable fuels, chemicals, and materials.

product.name: Carbon Capture and Utilization Technology
product.description: A biological process that captures carbon-rich waste gases from industrial sources and converts them into sustainable raw materials like ethanol for fuels, chemicals, and materials.

product.name: Sustainable Ethanol Production
product.description: Production of fuel-grade ethanol from industrial waste gases using gas fermentation technology for use in fuels and consumer products.

product.name: Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) Production
product.description: Conversion of waste carbon emissions into sustainable aviation fuel through biological fermentation processes.

product.name: CarbonSmart™ Chemical Intermediates
product.description: Production of chemical intermediates like acetone, isopropanol, and other hydrocarbons from waste carbon gases for use in manufacturing various products.

product.name: End-of-Life Tire Recycling Technology
product.description: A process that converts waste tires into sustainable chemicals and materials, including synthetic rubber, using carbon capture and gas fermentation.

identifier.value: Isoprene Production from Waste Rubber and Resins

product.name: Isoprene Production from Waste Rubber and Resins
product.description: Biological production of isoprene, a key natural rubber component, from recycled rubber, resin, and urethane waste.
